title: Horizon Implementation Day: Grant Management in Horizon Europe
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: Running a Horizon Europe grant: amendments, reporting and payments, and the Commission's approach to fraud prevention, detection and corrections.
covers: Amendments: the legal basis, the business process and the IT tool
Reporting and payments: the legal basis, common errors, the process and the IT tool
Question-and-answer sessions on amendments and on reporting
materials: Agenda and presentation slides for each session
why: Most problems in running projects come from amendments and periodic reports. Project managers and finance staff should know these rules before the first reporting period closes.
source_name: European Commission · Research and innovation community platform (related webinars)
